STS2WD-REALTA_LEGACY.title: Legacy
STS2WD-REALTA_LEGACY.description: Can be Upgraded and receive stackable enchantments repeatedly.
STS2WD-REALTA_REFINE.title: Refine
STS2WD-REALTA_REFINE.description: For this combat, an Attack gains [gold]Sharp[/gold]; any other card gains [gold]Adroit[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_GUARD.title: Guard
STS2WD-REALTA_GUARD.description: Increase the [gold]Block[/gold] of ALL [gold]Steel Guardian[/gold] cards by this amount. If none exist, create one in your hand.
STS2WD-REALTA_SPELL.title: Spell
STS2WD-REALTA_SPELL.description: The bonus activates if you have 0 energy after paying the cost.
STS2WD-REALTA_MASTERWORK.title: Masterwork
STS2WD-REALTA_DUEL.title: Duel
STS2WD-REALTA_DUEL.description: The bonus activates if the target enemy has neither [gold]Weak[/gold] nor [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_VALOR.title: Valor
STS2WD-REALTA_VALOR.description: The bonus activates if the target enemy has Strength or Block.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_REFORM.title: Reform
STS2WD-ALTHEA_REFORM.description: Transform into the token for its original type this combat, retaining upgraded status and compatible enchantments.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CLASH.title: Clash
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CLASH.description: Active if you or a living enemy is at or below half HP immediately before the effect.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_UNFADING.title: Unfading
STS2WD-ALTHEA_UNFADING.description: When Exhausted or transformed, return a copy using deck-original upgrades and enchantments. Generated cards retain only upgraded status.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FRENZY.title: Frenzy
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FRENZY.description: When an adjacent hand card is played, automatically play this next, spending up to its normal cost from remaining Energy.
